skills.description: Move the robot's end-effector or mobile base to a named location or position.
effects: robot (end-effector or base) is at target_location

skills.description: Move the robot's end-effector or mobile base by a relative offset from its current position (e.g. 5cm forward).
effects: robot has moved by the specified offset

skills.description: Rotate either the robot itself (mobile base spinning in place, or arm reorienting) or a currently held/reachable object, by a given angle around a specified axis. Omit object_name to rotate the robot itself rather than an object.
preconditions: object is reachable or held (only if object_name is given)
effects: robot or specified object is reoriented

skills.description: Immediately halt all current motion of the robot, arm or mobile base.
Immediately halt all motion and disable further movement until manually reset. Highest-priority safety skill, applicable to any robot type.
effects: robot is halted and movement is disabled until reset

skills.description: Pause and hold current state for a specified duration before continuing.
Report the robot's current battery or power level, if the robot has power-monitoring capability.
Close the gripper to grasp whatever is currently in contact with it.
Open the gripper to release the currently held object.
High-level skill: move to object location then grip it.

High-level skill: move to target location then release held object. Target may be a target_location (named/literal), a landmark (top_left, top_right, bottom_left, bottom_right, center), or relative_to another object plus direction (left, right, front, behind, above, below) and distance -- see system prompt rules on spatial placement.
Examine an object closely to determine its properties or condition.
preconditions: object is in field of view
effects: object properties and condition are known

skills.description: Push an object in a specified direction by a given distance.
effects: object has moved in specified direction

skills.description: Return the arm to its default rest/home position.
High-level skill: navigate to a named location using path planning and obstacle avoidance (unlike move_to, which is a direct low-level move).
Attach a named cube to the mobile robot so it can be transported. The cube teleports onto the robot and is locked to it until detached. Use this after navigating to the cube's zone.
preconditions: mobile robot is at the cube's zone
effects: cube is attached to mobile robot

skills.description: Detach the currently carried cube from the mobile robot, leaving it at the robot's current position. Use this after navigating to the handoff point.
preconditions: cube is attached to mobile robot
mobile robot is at handoff point

skills.description: Follow a pre-planned sequence of waypoints.
Compute a path from the current position to a target location, avoiding known obstacles.
effects: a path to target_location is known

skills.description: React to a detected obstacle by adjusting course to prevent collision.
Use onboard sensors to identify obstacles in the robot's path.
effects: obstacle presence and location are known

skills.description: Build a new map of the environment using onboard sensors (SLAM).
effects: a map of the environment exists

skills.description: Update the existing map with new sensor data.
Determine the robot's current position within a known map.
Move to and physically/electrically connect with a charging or docking station.
Disconnect from the docking station and become free to move.
effects: robot is undocked and free to move
